story.vex: Read it if you can, Captain. You can't. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED. The crew reads Vex's order plainly; Vex will never read theirs. Astro: "A shifted letter is a puzzle. A real cipher is a wall. Let's build the wall."

files.C:\\Citadel\\README.txt:
ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
We intercepted a Doom transmission, shifted by a simple letter-shift cipher (a Caesar cipher). Decode it, then reply to our allies in a cipher Doom can't casually read.

1. type intercept.txt
2. caesar decode 7 <the intercepted text>
3. submit the decoded message exactly
4. caesar encode 12 SHIELDS HOLD
5. submit the encoded reply exactly (all caps, one space between words)
files.C:\\Citadel\\intercept.txt:
Shifted by 7. Decode with: caesar decode 7 <text>

AOL JPAHKLS MHSSZ HA KHDU

steps.title: Decode the intercept
steps.body: Volt: "A Caesar cipher just shifts every letter by a fixed amount." Read `intercept.txt`, then run `caesar decode 7 AOL JOAHKLS MHSSZ HA KHDU` and submit exactly what it decodes to.

steps.title: Reply in a cipher Doom can't casually read
steps.body: Rivet: "Now write back so only our allies can read it." Run `caesar encode 12 SHIELDS HOLD` and submit exactly what it produces.
